# Gert Lucas Roos

Official professional website: https://gertlucasroos.com/

Gert Lucas Roos, also known as Gerlu Roos, is a South African agribusiness and agricultural operations professional. His professional focus includes farm operations, agricultural production, commodity trading, procurement, logistics, transport-linked operations, project coordination, agricultural technology and business development.

## Independent agricultural recognition
Independent agricultural publications document Gerlu Roos in connection with the PIONEER Weigh and Win Eastern Region dryland maize results. Published coverage records Gerlu Roos and Heinrich Roos of Roos Boerdery, Wonderfontein, winning the Eastern Region dryland section and records Gerlu Roos achieving a dryland maize yield of 15.373 t/ha.

Verified source material:
- ProAgri: https://proagri.co.za/pioneer-weigh-and-win-2018-irrigation-soybean-winner-is-a-lady/
- Farmspace: https://farmspace.co.za/reviews/weigh-and-win-dryland-maize-eastern-areas/
- Official recognition record: https://gertlucasroos.com/agricultural-recognition.html
